:speech_balloon: alexcrichton created PR review comment:

Have you perhaps benchmarked this without specifying any custom hasher here for your workload at all?

Additionally, with a more official hasher, could you explore changing the u64 here to (VMSharedTypeIndex, VMSharedTypeIndex)?
:memo: MythicByte submitted PR review.

:speech_balloon: MythicByte created PR review comment:

I have tried (VMSharedTypeIndex, VMSharedTypeIndex) and it performs a bit worse like _0.1 ns_, i don't now if it for maintenance better this would be your decision. I would say go to default std hashmap to eliminate maintenance burden, the margin efficient increase are not worth it ?

Thanks for collecting that! For 0.1ns changes that's pretty much noise, so for ergonomics can this PR also switch to the tuple? As for the default-vs-not, I think it'd be reasonable to use FixedState here or the default RandomState, up to you.

This doubled the instructions retired on hoot-earley-boyer and +61% instructions retired on dart-deltablue: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/issues/15248

I think we want to revert this change and investigate another approach.
